entities.summary: Elvia Fernanda Torres Pérez, known professionally as Elyfer Torres, is a Mexican actress. Her first major role was portraying the titular character in the Telemundo telenovela Betty en NY (2019). Although previously she stood out for series like La rosa de Guadalupe (2012–2017), La Piloto (2018), El secreto de Selena (2018), and Nicky Jam: El Ganador (2018).
